title: AegisPerformanceMetricsEvent
description: Formal JSON Schema for AEGIS pipeline performance telemetry events and latency measurements.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this telemetry measurement event.

trace_id.description: Trace correlation identifier linking all sub-events of a single user interaction.

task_id.description: Task identifier associated with the specific operational step.

stage_name.description: The discrete lifecycle pipeline stage measured.

execution_path.description: The routing path taken for the enclosing task execution.

timestamp_start.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking the beginning of the stage.

timestamp_end.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking the conclusion of the stage.

duration_ms.description: Total elapsed duration for this stage in milliseconds.

status.description: Outcome status of the stage execution.

hardware_context.description: Point-in-time hardware load indicators during stage execution.

metadata.description: Sanitized, non-secret diagnostic metadata relating to the event.
